name: podcast
hook: I ran this podcast through a live claim meter.

questions.label: Factual claim
questions.instructions: Does this sentence make a specific, checkable factual claim?

questions.label: Unsupported claim
questions.instructions: Does this sentence assert something as true without any evidence, source or reasoning?

questions.label: Overgeneralization
questions.instructions: Does this sentence make a sweeping generalization (always, never, everyone, nobody)?

questions.label: Emotional appeal
questions.instructions: Does this sentence rely mainly on emotion (outrage, fear, ridicule) rather than evidence?

questions.label: Self-promotion
questions.instructions: Is this sentence promoting the speaker, their product, sponsor or brand?
